description: Play-session counts (GET /v1/usage/plays) over a range, grouped by collection (default), track, creator, or day; use group_by=none for a total plus a day/month time series. Play sessions are the primary play metric (one per playback open). Answers "how many plays this week, broken down by collection/creator". Note: plays from directly signed (HMAC) URLs are not counted, and there is no per-output-preset breakdown (R2 operations are aggregated per organization). Requires a full API Access key. Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_get_plays
